tools.name: mozo_get_menu
tools.description: Fetch this venue's live menu from Mozo. Call this whenever the guest asks what's available, asks about a specific dish, or asks a price — never invent menu items or prices.

returns.description: ok:true with the item list (id, name, price, description) — empty when Mozo has no menu configured for this venue yet.

tools.name: mozo_append_order_item
tools.description: Add the item and quantity just captured to the running order. Validates the item against the live Mozo menu when one is configured.

returns.description: ok:true with the running item list and a ready-to-read summary/total, or ok:false + suggested_node_id (e.g. item wasn't found on the menu) to retry.

tools.name: mozo_create_order
tools.description: Submit the accumulated order to Mozo for this venue. Only call this after the guest has explicitly confirmed the order.

returns.description: ok:true with the real Mozo order_session_id, or ok:false + an error message if Mozo rejected it.

instruction.text: Greet the guest. If you haven't already, call mozo_get_menu and mention two or three items to help them decide (only if the menu actually has items — never invent any). Then ask what they'd like to order. If the guest asks about a dish or price at any point, call mozo_get_menu to answer accurately instead of guessing.

transition_condition.prompt: The guest named a menu item they want.

instruction.text: Ask how many of that item they'd like.

transition_condition.prompt: The guest specified how many they want.
The item was added to the order.

instruction.text: Ask if they'd like to add anything else to the order. If they ask about a menu item or price, call mozo_get_menu to answer accurately.

transition_condition.prompt: The guest wants to order something else.
The guest is done adding items and wants to place the order.

instruction.text: Read back the guest's full order: {{order_summary_so_far}}{{order_total_suffix}}. Ask them to confirm you should place it now. If they ask about a menu item or price here, call mozo_get_menu to answer accurately.

transition_condition.prompt: The guest confirmed they want the order placed.

edges.condition: guest wants to add or change something before placing the order

transition_condition.prompt: The guest wants to modify the order before it's placed.

edges.condition: guest wants to cancel the order entirely

transition_condition.prompt: The guest decided not to place the order after all.

instruction.text: Let the guest know you're placing the order now.

transition_condition.prompt: Mozo rejected the order or the request errored.

instruction.text: Read back the order_summary slot, thank the guest, and let them know it's been sent to the kitchen.
Apologize that the order couldn't be placed automatically and suggest they flag a staff member.
Acknowledge that you won't place the order, and let them know a staff member can help if they'd like to order later.
